# FROM NOTHING - Linkin Park tribute band

> Official website of From Nothing, a Polish Linkin Park tribute band.

From Nothing performs the music of Linkin Park live. This website contains the band's concert information, lineup, official social profiles, and booking contact details.

## Language versions

The official website is available in two language variants:

- [Polish version](https://fromnothing.pl/)
- [English version](https://fromnothing.pl/?lang=en)

## Members

- Mery: vocals
- Janusz: vocals and guitar
- Patryk: guitar
- Wojtek: drums
- Damian: bass guitar

## Official profiles and contact

- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/FromNothingPoland/)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@FromNothingPoland)
- Booking: kontakt@fromnothing.pl
